messages:
maya: Quick ping — small PR changing attention kernel fallback order + an opt-in `kv_prefetch=true` flag. Need eyes & a quick perf sanity check; aiming to merge before EOD. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1428 :pray:

jon: Link? curious about the fallback ordering — does this affect long-context perf?

maya: Yep: swapping the fallback from `soft_attention` -> `fast_attention` to prefer `fast` when sequence < 512. Also added a guard so older models keep old path. Bench on an 8k token trace shows tail latency median down ~8% locally. Pasted quick run below.

maya: ```bash
# quick local bench
tools/bench/attn_bench.py --model gpt-small --seq 8192 --runs 10 --seed 42
# main: median 980 t/s
# pr:   median 1060 t/s
```

sasha: :eyes: I can look in ~30m. Any risk to KV cache shape? i.e., cache key layout change?

maya: No cache layout changes. Prefetch only toggles whether we warm KV on partial requests before full token gen. No schema changes. Tests added: `tests/attention/test_prefetch.py` and a small integration smoke.

ci-bot: CI results: 12/12 checks passed. Perf/regression-suite: baseline vs PR -> median delta -7.6% (tokens/sec).

lee: Can you paste the exact bench command and seed? want to replicate.

maya: command: `tools/bench/attn_bench.py --model gpt-small --seq 512 --runs 20 --seed 42` output: `median 1251 t/s -> 1345 t/s` (PR vs main).

olga: Please add a short comment in the code pointing to the canary plan and a note about the guard for older models. Also add a changelog entry and bump the migration note.

maya: Added comment + changelog entry in last commit. PTAL.

sasha: Left 2 tiny nits but no blockers. Approving after fix.

maya: Fixed both nits. Thanks! @jon want me to do a canary rollout after merge or you prefer to schedule?

jon: I'll schedule a canary at 19:00 UTC. Merge once `release-bot` green and @jon confirmed.

ci-bot: Merge check: all green. Merge allowed by policy.

maya: :shipit: merging now.

ci-bot: Merged and created canary deploy job #canary-1428 scheduled for 2026-03-18T19:00:00Z :rocket:

sasha: :thumbsup:
